semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Bamac Electric specializes in power electronics and automation control equipment, which are relevant to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Bamac Electrical Equipment (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer of high-performance power electronics and automation control products, particularly known for their all-air-cooled induction heating technology. Their products are utilized across various industries, including microelectronics, making them relevant to semiconductor manufacturing.

regional_presence.China: Bamac Electric is located in Qingpu District, Shanghai, covering an area of 8,309 square meters.
